preconditions.expression: all(line.strip().isdigit() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip())
preconditions.description: Every non-empty line in stdin consists of one or more digits.
The first line is T (1 ≤ T ≤ 1000), the number of test cases.
Each of the next T lines contains exactly two space-separated integers.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(L) <= int(R) <= 10**9 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for L, R in [line.split()])
preconditions.description: For each test case, L and R satisfy 1 ≤ L ≤ R ≤ 10^9.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.strip()) > 0 and line.strip().isdigit() for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each line of stdout is a non-empty string of digits representing the answer modulo 1,000,000,007.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(line.strip()) < 10**9 + 7 for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each answer is a non-negative integer less than 1,000,000,007.
The number of output lines equals T, the number of test cases.

postconditions.expression: all((lambda L, R: sum(int(x) * len(str(x)) for x in range(int(L), int(R) + 1))) % (10**9 + 7) == int(line.strip()) for line, (L, R) in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is the sum of goodness (x * number of digits in x) for all integers x from L to R, inclusive, modulo 1,000,000,007.
